title: Area Controlled by White Wolf Squad
Secret Safe
info: Electronic Safe located near the Backstage Area door. Does not require a key to access from the East (20 second timer). Not so secret anymore now that you know about it, is it?

title: Loading Dock Extract
info: Requirement: Flip the Ventilation Stairs Switch. This is active after 15 minutes into the raid. Extract takes 20 seconds.

title: Ventilation Stairs Switch
info: Pulling this opens the Loading Dock Extract. Once switch is pulled, extract will remain open for the rest of the raid. Located half-way up the first set of stairs in the ventilation area. Pulling this will alert the map.

title: Radar Station Switch
info: Pulling this opens the Radar Station Extract in the same room. Once switch is pulled, extract will remain open for the rest of the raid. Pulling this will alert the map.

title: Main Extract
info:
Requirement: Flip a switch at the Main Entrance to activate the extraction point. This is active after 10 minutes into the raid.
Extraction timer is 60 sec

title: Elevator Extract
info:
Requirement: You must call an elevator from the second floor Elevator Corridor. This is active after 10 minutes into the raid. Single-use. Once it's red, you can not call it again. Calling the elevator announces to the whole map.

Roughly 20 second timer from pressing Call to the elevator arriving, plus 160 seconds to the doors closing and the extract leaving. Text reads 'The elevator will be activated in 3min'. Be inside the elevator when the countdown ends to extract safely. Good luck.

title: Editing Room Key
info: Editing Room key used to open the Editing Room on the 2nd floor of the TV Station Set-Up aarea, which contains lots of precious supplies. There are 2 staircases you can use to get to the second floor of this room, but there is very little cover.

title: 2F General Office Key
info: The General Office Key is used to open the large General Office on the second floor of the TV Station.

title: 2F General Office Safe
info: Safe in the 2F General Office.

title: 2F Director's Officecard
info: The Director's Officecard is used to open the Director's Office on the second floor of the TV Station. After the North-South Conflict broke out, the staff left Guoyapos in a hurry and didn't have time to pack up their belongings.

title: Director's Office Safe
info: Electronic Safe located on the second floor right outside the Director's Office under a desk (20 second timer).

title: Central Control Area Safe
info: Located in the center of the Central Control Area (20 second timer).

title: Live Broadcast Room Safe
info: Located in the south-west of the Central Control Area (20 second timer) - It's also not much of a room.
